article.title: Enforcement of decrees and orders.
article.content: All decrees and orders made by the court in any proceeding under this Act shall be enforced in the like manner as the decrees and orders of the court made in the exercise of its original civil jurisdiction for the time being enforced.]
article.html:
28AEnforcement of decrees and orders.

Section 28A · Jurisdiction and procedure · page 15 of the Act

All decrees and orders made by the court in any proceeding under this Act shall be enforced in the like manner as the decrees and orders of the court made in the exercise of its original civil jurisdiction for the time being enforced.]
